references.use: Pinned 5.2.1 in the replaceable historical chart adapter; attribution is visible and LICENSE/NOTICE are copied into the UI assets.

references.name: FINOS Workspace (formerly OpenBB Workspace)
references.use: The widget metadata binds endpoints, data arguments and default display. The MCP data tool accepts an exact widget identity and explicit arguments. Use these as an optional integration reference. In ScopeHub custom views consume authorized data independently of a widget and identify the frozen evidence revision.

references.name: OpenChart
references.use: Chart-context research, indicator execution, shared operation catalog and permission lifecycle reference; M1-M4

references.name: FinRobot Desktop
references.use: Data provenance, stale-cache semantics and financial computation candidates; distinguish Desktop V2 from the PyPI V0 package

references.name: OpenStock

references.name: Omniscience
references.use: Candidate upstream for evidence-grounded research, temporal queries, disagreements and corrections; current active profile is AI, not general financial coverage

references.name: Playwright
references.use: Pinned 1.65.1 development-only Chromium 159.0.8154.6 verification. Includes the upstream Windows TCP source-port randomization fix (Playwright #43605). Uses the real Rust/Python backend through a substitute WebView transport. Packaged desktop acceptance is verified separately.

references.name: Open Data Platform (ODP V5)
references.use: Candidate for M1-009. Its Fetcher transforms a query, extracts provider data and normalizes results. Compare one provider against direct access with actual entitlement and provenance. ODP V5 has Apache-2.0 licensing, V4 retains AGPL and provider data has separate terms.
